_comment: STATE 2 CUTOVER COMPLETE (2026-08-28): veloso.dev/www.veloso.dev now serve the Astro app
directly (DNS flipped from the old Lightsail A record to a CNAME at the Cloudflare Tunnel;
see ../veloso.dev/RELAUNCH-PLAN.md §8). p.veloso.dev's role reversed -- it no longer needs
to serve the app itself, so it joins this 'aliases' group as a fourth entry redirecting to
veloso.dev, same as pv/resume/cv. All group 'enabled' flags below are kept in sync with the
live zone -- if you ever hand-edit this file, re-check `redirect-ruleset veloso.dev --status`
first, since --apply replaces the WHOLE live ruleset in one PUT and would silently revert
any group whose 'enabled' here doesn't match reality.
Group 'aliases': pv/resume/cv/p.veloso.dev -> veloso.dev, path preserved.
Group 'blog-redirect': veloso.dev's old WordPress post/category/tag links -> their
systemsnotsilos.com equivalents (see ../veloso.dev/RELAUNCH-PLAN.md §4). Enabled
2026-08-28 (was created disabled, then turned on once State 1 was verified -- see
decision-log.md-equivalent history in this repo's git log).
Path/permalink structure confirmed by a direct DB query against both veloso.dev and
systemsnotsilos.com (RELAUNCH-PLAN.md §1/§3) -- do not hand-edit the expressions below
without re-checking that structure hasn't changed.
The 'posts' rule uses starts_with year-prefix branches instead of a regex: this account's
Cloudflare plan doesn't have the `matches` operator entitlement (Business/WAF Advanced
only). starts_with is a FUNCTION in Cloudflare's expression language (`starts_with(field,
"value")`), not an infix operator -- an earlier version of this file used infix syntax and
failed to parse; fixed 2026-08-28. Years cover 2023-2027 (published posts run 2023-05-05 to
2026-07-08 per RELAUNCH-PLAN.md §1, plus one year of buffer); the blog now lives permanently
on systemsnotsilos.com so veloso.dev shouldn't gain new dated posts, but extend this list if
it ever does.

rules.name: p
rules.description: p.veloso.dev -> veloso.dev (path preserved). Added 2026-08-28 as part of the State 2 cutover -- p.veloso.dev's role reversed from canonical to alias.

rules.name: posts
rules.description: Dated post permalinks (/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/) -> systemsnotsilos.com. Regex-free (starts_with year branches) so it works on this account's Cloudflare plan.
rules.expression: (http.host in {"veloso.dev" "www.veloso.dev"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/2023/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/2024/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/2025/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/2026/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/2027/")))
